subject.title: Feature Request: Configurable Session Lane Concurrency + Auto-Yield

question: Should OpenClaw add core session-lane concurrency and auto-yield config now, and what ordering, cancellation, transcript-safety, and tool-side-effect contract should those knobs enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior changes core session scheduling and public config in a compatibility-sensitive area; automation cannot choose the permanent safety model or product semantics.

options.title: Design scheduler contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker while maintainers define the concurrency, auto-yield, ordering, cancellation, transcript-safety, and upgrade contract, and review the diagnostics slice separately.

options.title: Ship diagnostics only for now
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86676 as the near-term log-noise fix and explicitly defer session concurrency and auto-yield.

options.title: Decline new core knobs
options.body: Close this direction in favor of existing `/queue steer`, `/queue interrupt`, subagent delegation, and explicit `sessions_yield` behavior.

recommendation.title: Design scheduler contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker while maintainers define the concurrency, auto-yield, ordering, cancellation, transcript-safety, and upgrade contract, and review the diagnostics slice separately.
